notes.title: Winter Update (1.2.1, Dec 27th 2021)
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Speed Mazers!

Winter season has come to Speed Mazing too! Enjoy brand new stage - the Frozen Pond. But that's not the only new thing coming today!
Here's a full list of changes:
- New Frozen Pond stage for all VS modes.
- Funtastic Plastic and Magic Cavern added to 4P VS mode.
- 40 new maps for 2P mode and 110 new maps for 4P mode (yup, that's a total of 150 new stages).
- Improved handling of reconnection of the controllers.

Please enjoy this new content! And if you've been waiting for a good time to get Speed Mazing - now is the best time, as we're having a Winter Sale!

notes.title: Update Notes (version 1.0.4, Oct 27, 2021)
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Speed Mazing players!

Last few days were a bit intensive, as we were hunting an elusive error preventing some of you from moving the characters in the game. With a tremendous help from ⚡ChenZshuo⚡ ( https://steamcommunity.com/id/chenzs2324 ) we were able to hunt that bug down. As it turned out - it affected some high refresh G-Sync displays with V-Sync turned off in the driver settings. The problem should now be fixed, so you should all be able to enjoy Speed Mazing with your friends and loved ones.
There was also a small change in German localization, as suggested by P4InKiLLeR ( https://steamcommunity.com/id/P4InKiLLeR_GER ) - Vielen Dank!

We hope you're all having good time with Speed Mazing! Don't be affraid to visit our community or leave us a review!
